title: BLDG-4 — Assemble, visualise, inspect, revise and release the model
desc:
READ FIRST: https://github.com/dreamer2664/buildinglab/blob/main/briefs/BLENDER.md and https://github.com/dreamer2664/buildinglab/blob/main/README.md.
DELIVERABLE: The final assembled `scene/building-final.blend`, clean-reimport-checked `exports/building-final.glb`, six floor plans, at least 29 named PNG renders at the charter sizes, model/render/hash manifests, asset rights, two recorded visual-review/fix cycles, exhaustive handoff, and a digest-verified storagecode release/archive.
EVIDENCE: `blender --background scene/building-final.blend --python tools/validate_scene.py` → `PASS`; `blender --background scene/building-final.blend --python tools/test_export.py` → `PASS`; `python3 tools/validate_visual_package.py` → `PASS`. Open every final image individually at full size; log view, issue, fix and reinspection in `evidence/visual-review.json`. Upload, re-download and hash-check `.blend`, `.glb` and all release images.
OWNS: `scene/building-final.blend`, `exports/**`, `renders/**`, `evidence/producer/**`, `tools/validate_scene.py`, `tools/test_export.py`, `tools/validate_visual_package.py`, final `HANDOFF.md`
BRANCH: `agent/blender/t-20261016-58d8`
REVIEW CARD: t-20261016-08c6
PARENT: t-20261016-3fe5. Assembly dependencies: t-20261016-0d4e, t-20261016-61b0. 29 minimum images: 2 exterior 4K; 1 full-building cutaway 4K; 6 floor cutaways 4K; 12 interior views ≥2560×1440; 6 labelled plans ≥2560×1440; 2 technical views ≥2560×1440. Two real inspect→fix→inspect cycles; no unresolved critical/major defect.
